key_path: Gemini API (fastest): sign in to aistudio.google.com with any Google account and accept the ToS. A default Cloud project + API key are auto-created for new users
Copy the key from aistudio.google.com/apikey. Since 2026-05-28 new keys are 'authorization keys' bound to a service account
Call generativelanguage.googleapis.com with x-goog-api-key. The free tier needs no card

CLI alternative: `gcloud auth login` (browser) > `gcloud projects create` > `gcloud services enable generativelanguage.googleapis.com` > create a restricted/auth key via the API Keys API (`gcloud services api-keys create --api-target=service=generativelanguage.googleapis.com`)
Vertex AI / Cloud MCP: link a billing account (card required) and use ADC via `gcloud auth application-default login`
human_gates_notes: A Google account sign-in (often with phone verification on new accounts) is the only gate for the AI Studio free tier. A card is needed only for paid tier / Vertex / Cloud. Existing Cloud users must 'import' projects into AI Studio, and IAM permissions (iam.serviceAccounts.create, serviceAccountApiKeyBindings.create) are needed to create auth keys.

agent_native_auth.cli_login: yes. `gcloud auth login` / `gcloud auth application-default login` browser flow (and --no-browser remote flow)
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: no. Cloud remote MCP servers explicitly do NOT support dynamic client registration; Claude/Cursor/ChatGPT need a manually created OAuth web client ID+secret. The Gemini Docs MCP needs no auth
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mint_keys: yes. API Keys API / gcloud services api-keys, service-account-bound auth keys
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes. API-target restrictions; auth keys restricted to Generative Language API by default; unrestricted standard keys rejected
agent_native_auth.sandbox_test_credentials: free tier serves as the sandbox
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes. Gemini API free tier with no card

docs_mcp.install: `npx add-mcp "https://gemini-api-docs-mcp.dev"` auto-configures detected agents; `claude mcp add --transport http geminiDocs https://gemini-api-docs-mcp.dev`

product_mcp.url: Google Cloud remote MCP servers per service, e.g. https://bigquery.googleapis.com/mcp, https://aiplatform.googleapis.com/mcp/models, Compute Engine, GKE, Maps
product_mcp.auth: OAuth 2.0 client ID/secret (manual), ADC, or bearer from `gcloud auth application-default print-access-token`
product_mcp.enable: `gcloud beta services mcp enable SERVICE --project=PROJECT`; needs roles/mcp.toolUser

mcp.plugin: Gemini API plugin for Antigravity bundles the docs MCP, skills and API-key tools (`agy plugin install https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-skills`)

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: yes. https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/llms.txt (root ai.google.dev/llms.txt 404; cloud.google.com/llms.txt returns an HTML page with 200, a soft-404)
docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes. Every page has a .md.txt variant (e.g. /gemini-api/docs/api-key.md.txt)

score_justification: A key is auto-provisioned on first AI Studio visit with a no-card free tier, plus gcloud CLI, a keys API, scoped auth keys, a docs MCP with an add-mcp one-liner, skills and .md.txt pages. Docked only because Cloud MCP lacks DCR.
best_practice: Auto-creating a default project + API key the moment a user accepts ToS, plus a 'Coding agent setup' page that ships skills, a docs MCP and machine-readable docs together
biggest_gap: Cloud remote MCP servers require a hand-made OAuth client (no DCR) for Claude/Cursor. Also the key-type migration (unrestricted standard keys rejected) breaks older agent-generated code
